test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If 12 students can read 4800 pages of a book in 15 days, then how many students can read 7200 pages of the same book in 10 days?
solution:
**Given:**

12 students can read 4800 pages in 15 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work = Number of Students × Number of Days

**Calculation:**

Let the number of students required be x.

Work done by 12 students in 15 days = 12 × 15

Total pages read = 4800

Pages read per student per day = 4800 / (12 × 15)

Pages read per student per day = 4800 / 180

Pages read per student per day = 26.67

Total pages to be read = 7200

Number of days = 10

Pages read per student in 10 days = 26.67 × 10

Pages read per student in 10 days = 266.7

Total number of students required = 7200 / 266.7

Total number of students required ≈ 27

**The correct answer is option 2.**
